annotations.title: Check a package or tool against known malware

description: Check an npm or PyPI package name, or an Agent Tested slug, against Agent Tested's list of known malicious look-alikes of MCP servers and agent tools (from GitHub-reviewed malware advisories and OSV MAL records) and against tools marked 'Dangerous: avoid'. Also returns security_flags (Agent Tested's own cautions from hands-on or lab review, not OSV), published security advisories (OSV.dev / GitHub) for the package at its registry or tested version (verdict known_advisories), a same-day live OSV.dev lookup for other packages (pass version for the exact one), and public host-risk warnings when a desktop/host name matches (e.g. silent agent-config injection). Use it before installing an MCP server or agent package. Not being listed does not prove a package is safe.

version.description: Optional exact version you plan to install; the live OSV.dev lookup then reports only advisories affecting it
